title: Reducing annotator bias by belief elicitation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the methodology of data annotation (belief elicitation) to reduce socio-demographic bias (specifically political affiliation) in NLP tasks. While it uses morally sensitive topics such as abortion and the death penalty as experimental stimuli to elicit biased judgements, the research goal is the reduction of annotator bias rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves.
